description: Real-time quote(s) for Chinese A-share stocks by 6-digit code (Shanghai 6xxxxx, Shenzhen 0xxxxx/3xxxxx, STAR 688xxx, ChiNext 30xxxx, Beijing 8xxxxx/4xxxxx). Returns name, current price, change and change %, open, previous close, day high/low, volume, turnover, and the quote timestamp. Accepts one code or a comma-separated list. Example: ashares_quote({ symbols: "600519,000858" }) for Kweichow Moutai and Wuliangye. Source: Sina (keyless).

symbols.description: One 6-digit code or a comma-separated list, e.g. "600519" or "600519,000001,300750". sh/sz/bj prefixes are accepted but optional.

name: ashares_quote
